note: In the 12th District Court of Appeals race for the term beginning 1/1/2027, the Board of Elections says Matthew Byrne withdrew and votes cast for him will not be counted. Write-in candidates Victor M. Haddad and Curt Carl Hartman also withdrew, so Willa Concannon is the remaining declared write-in candidate. Not shown: state legislative and congressional districts; school district issues (Bethel-Tate Local, U.S. Grant Joint Vocational); township fire levies (Batavia, Union and Washington townships); and precinct local-liquor-option questions. The Board of Elections does not number local issues. Check your official sample ballot for district and local items.

measures.id: Clermont County Children Services Tax Levy
measures.title: Clermont County – Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal), 0.8 Mill, 5 Years: Children Services
measures.summary: Asks whether Clermont County may renew a 0.8-mill property tax for 5 years. The money supports children services and the care and placement of children.
measures.yesMeans: The 0.8-mill children services levy is renewed for 5 years.
